reasoning: The test image shows a sugarcane leaf with pronounced yellow/pale-yellow coloration along the lower midrib (abaxial) surface while the upper (adaxial) surface remains green. This 'yellow back' or yellow midrib symptom running linearly along the leaf length is the classic diagnostic feature of Yellow Leaf disease (SCYLV). The small orange-red spot in the yellow zone is consistent with secondary changes seen in Yellow Leaf. Other classes like Leaf_Scald (more white/scorched), Yellow_Spot (discrete spots on green tissue), and Streak_Mosaic (mosaic pattern throughout blade) do not match this pattern.
